plugins.name: claylee-core
plugins.description: Behavioral contract rule + a Stop hook that flags console.log in git-changed files + a push-guard mod for projects with .claude/push-checks.json

plugins.name: claylee-e2e-testing
plugins.description: Playwright E2E testing skill with Page Object Model patterns, configuration templates, and 7 /e2e:* commands (analyze, plan, create, maintain, run, remote, record).

plugins.name: claylee-code-quality-agents
plugins.description: Four sub-agents for on-demand code work: code-review, build-error-resolver, security-reviewer, refactor-cleaner.

plugins.name: claylee-openspec
plugins.description: OpenSpec + Superpowers workflow injection. Conditionally injects workflow docs when project has openspec/ directory or .claude/openspec-enabled marker. Includes the retro-doc-sync skill.

plugins.name: claylee-alien-defense
plugins.description: Pixel-art pane mod: an alien lasers down the creatures each tool call brings; in OpenSpec projects the sky follows the change's stage from dawn to night and a boss appears at each stage change. Toggle with /alien.
